results.note: Several red and green autumn leaves overlap in a busy frame; the large red leaf in front shows outline and toothed margin clearly. Crowded with other leaves and twigs, so alone is false; autumn colour is not a cause.

A leafy green branch with many overlapping lobed leaves with toothed edges; a few lobes and margins read well. Crowded, so alone is false, and the red leaf stalks at the top only hint at the opposite arrangement.
A twig with red stalks joining it in opposite pairs, carrying autumn leaves in green, yellow, orange and red. Leaves overlap with a busy coloured background, so alone is false.
A whole trunk seen from a distance with moss covering much of it; the vertical furrows are small in the frame and the colour is changed by moss. Bark features need a search.

Crowded yellow autumn leaves fill the foreground, many cut by the frame edge, with a red tree in the background. The leaves look rounded and unlobed to me, which is odd for this tree, but I trust the source name. Margin and venation are small and need a search.
A small sapling in red and orange autumn colour with leaves that blend into a mass, with grass and flowers around. No single leaf outline is easy to read.
One green three-lobed leaf with a red stalk, sharp, upper side, with a soft dark background. Outline, toothed edge and veins are easy to read.
A dark grey trunk with pale lichen patches and a mostly smooth surface with faint ridges, in a forest scene. The trunk edges and a branch show; the fine texture needs a closer look.
The base of a multi-stem trunk with furrowed grey bark that reads clearly. Sun comes in behind the central stem, so that stem is backlit and its colour shifts.
A close, sharp view of rough grey bark with scaly plates and ridges, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object in the frame.
One red fallen leaf lies among brown leaf litter, pine needles and a mushroom. The outline shows, but the busy litter competes and the edge detail is small, so margin needs a search.
Rough, ridged and flaking grey-brown bark with fingers touching it at the left edge. The fingers cover a small part of the subject, so whole is false. The file is small but sharp.
A close shot of grey bark with scaly ridges and dark grooves, soft only at the left and right edges. The centre is sharp. No trunk edge or scale object is in the frame.
A whole trunk with narrow vertical grey ridges and fern and foliage behind it. The trunk edges show and the ridge pattern is readable.
One red, orange and green autumn leaf with a clear outline and toothed edge, against conifer needles. A second small leaf sits at lower left.
The camera looks up the trunk toward the crown with the sun flaring at the right. A birdhouse takes the middle of the frame, and the bark is hard to read.
Backlit autumn leaves in yellow, orange and red crowd the frame and overlap, with several cut by the edge. Backlight changes the colour and both sides show; the lobes and edges need a search.
A large close view of one leaf turning from green to red, with a clear outline, toothed edge and veins. The left lobe touches the frame edge, so whole is false.
A trunk with grey and brown scaly plates and furrows, and a small twig across it. Both trunk edges show, so the frame is not texture only.
The ground is covered with a mass of red, pink and brown fallen leaves that overlap, and no single leaf stands out. The leaves blend into a mass.
Pale pink-tan samara clusters hang among fresh leaves and twigs. The fruit is small in the frame and crowded by leaves, so kind, shape and wing need a search.
Close view of green-and-pink samaras hanging on stalks against a dark soft background. The nuts are still green and the wings pale pink, so I read them as full-size but unripe.
Red paired samaras hang on stalks from a twig against plain blue sky. Sharp, whole and uncluttered.
Red samara clusters hang from a twig in sun, with a soft warm background. The fruit overlaps in places but each pair is readable.

Green-and-red samaras hang on thin red stalks beside a trunk, with a soft background. The wings overlap and are slender, so the outline needs close study, and the greenish colour suggests unripe fruit.
Frame-filling rough, flaking bark with dark grooves and pale plates in sun. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale, so it is too close, and the plate pattern needs study.
Samara clusters hang on long red stalks from a twig, with a young leaf at upper left and a soft green background. The fruit is sharp and its stalks and wings are readable.
Whole trunk base on a lawn, shown with its edges. The bark is small in the frame, so the ridges and plates are found only with a search.
One whole five-lobed leaf on a long stalk against a black background, lit by flash. The flash gives a dull grey-green cast, and the pale raised veins suggest the underside.
Young red samaras with short unexpanded wings stand on stalks among remains of flowers, with a soft background. The fruit has not reached full shape, so it is young and the features need a search.
One whole green five-lobed leaf with its stalk, scanned on a plain black background. No scale object.
One whole green leaf lies on wood mulch. The outline reads well, but the busy mulch background competes with the leaf.
Orange-red samara clusters hang from a pale branch against a black night background, lit by flash. The flash changes the colour, and the dense clusters make single outlines hard to trace.
Samara clusters hang on long red stalks from a twig, with a young leaf at upper left and a soft green background. The fruit is sharp and readable.
Frame-filling rough, flaking grey-brown bark in even light. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale, so it is too close, and the plate pattern needs study.
A crown of orange autumn leaves blends into one mass, and no single leaf outline or edge can be read. Autumn colour is not counted as a cause.
Several green leaves overlap on a branch, with brown spots that leave the outline intact. The lead leaf at left is tilted and cut by the frame edge, so whole is false.
Small red samara clusters high on twigs against pine foliage and sky, seen from below. The fruit is small in the frame and competes with the twigs and pine.
Hanging red flower clusters on a bare twig against a soft grey sky. The subject is flowers only, so the part is other.
A yellow-orange autumn leaf with dark spots lies in a pile of other fallen leaves. Overlapping leaves and the frame edge hide part of its outline. Autumn colour is not counted as a cause.
Large green mature leaf seen from underneath and tilted, with its lobes and veins readable. Leaves and twigs in the background crowd it, so alone is false, and the margin takes some study.
Trunk fills the frame, both trunk edges show, and the furrows and plates read clearly. Soft background does not compete.
Whole trunk with ridges and plates sharp, trunk edges visible, a brick building behind it. The camera is level or only slightly up and does not look into the crown.
One whole green leaf on a plain white sheet, upper side up, with outline, lobe tips, margin and veins clear. No scale object and no twig, so size and arrangement are no.
Old trunk shot steeply from below, looking up into the branches and crown. The ridge pattern is only partly readable on the lower trunk, and the branches compete for the frame.
Sharp trunk with ridges and plates, both edges visible, a brick wall behind. Pattern repeat is wide enough to read.
A whole sapling in a garden bed, with a spruce trunk and fence behind it. The subject is the plant, not a leaf, bark or fruit, so the part is other. No single leaf can be read.
A young whole tree or sapling in a garden in sunlight, with hedges and lawn around it. The leaves blend into one mass, and no leaf outline is readable, so the part is other.

A twig on black with pairs of samaras hanging in a cluster. Seed bodies are still green and the wings pale, so the fruit is unripe. The pairs overlap, so single-fruit shape needs study. Leaves are in the frame but secondary.
A crown of orange autumn foliage against sky. The leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf is readable, so the part is other.
Massive old trunk in a meadow with moss on one side and large burls. Vertical ridges show, but moss and the sunlit, uneven surface mean the pattern takes some study.
Trunk fills the frame, both trunk edges visible, and the ridges and plates read clearly. Only a small part of the background shows.
Pale old trunk at a fork, with moss in patches, seen from below against blue sky and bare trees. Branches and background compete, and the ridge pattern is subtle and takes study.
Frame is all bark texture with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true. Ridges and plates are sharp. The strong orange-red cast looks like warm light and shifts the colour.
Old forked trunk in autumn woods with dappled sun and shadow across it. The shadows hide the ridges and change the colour, and the view is upward from low down.
One ripe tan samara pair with a short stalk on a plain purple background, with a 1 cm scale bar. Kind, outline and wings are clear. The fruit is off the twig, so hang is no.
Close crop of dark bark with moss and lichen and no trunk edge, branch or scale object. The ridge pattern is partly hidden by the green cover, so it takes study.
Frame is all bark with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true. Vertical ridges and plates are sharp and readable.
Whole trunk with both edges visible, ridges readable, and patches of lichen over the surface. The lichen changes the colour a little. A vine and one leaf are in the frame but small.

Pile of fallen autumn leaves in yellow, orange and red, overlapping each other. The central yellow leaf is mostly visible but partly covered, so its outline and edge take close study. Autumn colour, so usual_look is false.

A single sugar maple samara lies flat on snow, seen from above, with a green sprout coming from the seed. The germinating seed and the flat top view make it atypical and an unusual angle; the wing and seed outline are still plain.
A full trunk of white oak fills the frame with both edges visible. The narrow flaking ridges and grey colour read plainly.

A white oak branch seen from below with one central lobed leaf whose outline is readable. Other leaves and the sky compete with it, and the low view is an unusual angle; the twig is visible but the leaf stalk joins need a search.
One white oak leaf tilted to show its pale underside against a dark background. The lobes and edge are plain; the tilt and the dark flash-like lighting that greys the colour make it harder.
A white oak branch with overlapping lobed leaves and a few small green acorns in the middle. The leaves crowd each other and hide outlines, so the lobes and edge need a search.
A leafy white oak branch in bright sun with many overlapping leaves. A few deep-lobed leaves at the lower right can be traced, but only with a search among the crowd.
A hanging cluster of dry brown sugar maple samaras on the twig against a soft background. The warm low light adds a golden cast to the colour.
Two ripe white oak acorns on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar, one without its cap and one with it. Both outlines and the warty cap are plain; the scale bar is not a fault.
Wet white oak leaves on a branch seen from above over mulch. Several leaves are readable with their rounded lobes, but they overlap and compete, so the frame is crowded.
Green unripe white oak acorns with warty caps sit on a twig among leaves. They are unripe, so this is not the usual look; the caps and the way they sit on the twig are plain.
A whole trunk of white oak in partial shade on a street, with shallow flaking ridges and grey tone. A building behind is a mild distraction only.
A narrower trunk with blocky plates in a forest. Other trunks and undergrowth behind it compete for attention.
A wide white oak trunk on a lawn with shallow grey flaky ridges. Both trunk edges are in the frame and the surface is sharp.
A view from below up a forked sugar maple trunk into the crown. The main subject is the whole tree, so the part is other, and the low view is an unusual angle.
Green sugar maple samaras hanging from a twig against a soft background. They are full shape but still green and unripe, so this is not the usual look.
A close view of one white oak leaf with several holes and small galls near a lobe. The holes and galls break the outline in places, so it is damaged; the lobes are still readable.
A green unripe acorn with a warty cap sits behind the edge of a large leaf in the foreground. The leaf hides part of the nut and competes for attention, so the shape needs a search.
A twig of sugar maple samaras with green seed bodies and tan wings against a black background. The flash-style lighting shifts the colours, and the fruit is still unripe.
Three white oak leaves radiate from a twig tip over darker leaves, so their outlines and stalk joins are plain. The shaded, bluish light dulls the green colour.
A whole white oak trunk with deep vertical ridges and flaking plates, seen with a building and another trunk behind. The ridges and grey brown colour are plain.
One green acorn of full shape sits in its warty cap on a twig, with leaves soft behind it. It is not ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false.
Brown dead leaves lie in a heap on the ground with hard sun and deep shadow. The leaves overlap and the outlines are only traceable with study, so this is dead_leaf and light.
A cluster of four green, full-shaped acorns with warty caps on a twig, with big leaves around them. They are not ripe, so unripe. A blurred skin-tone shape at top left gives no usable scale.
One whole green leaf seen from its underside against a soft forest background. The lobes, the bristle-tipped teeth and the veins are readable. The twig junction is not shown, so arrangement is no.
A wide view of a mature trunk with deep, vertical, interlacing ridges, with both trunk edges and some lichen showing. A small tag on the trunk is not readable, so it is not a name_label.
Fresh light-green spring leaves hang from a twig, with a few small catkins between them and a soft background. The leaves have not reached full size or colour, so young.

The camera looks straight up the trunk into the crown. The trunk narrows to a dark strip and the crown takes much of the frame, so the ridge pattern is hard to read. This is bark_up_or_dark and angle.
Green, sharply lobed leaves on branches in dappled sun. Some leaves overlap and the frame edge cuts others, so whole and alone are false. The bristle tips are small, so margin is search.
Three green, full-shaped acorns with warty caps on a twig, with large leaves around them. They are not ripe, so unripe.

A few pale, thin leaves spring from one point on a mossy trunk, with no twig or hand showing. This looks like a trunk (epicormic or sucker) shoot, which I judge as sucker_leaf. This is the least certain call in the set.
Green lobed leaves on a low shoot over leaf litter. The image is small, so the bristle tips and veins need close study.

Backlit, translucent, new yellow-green leaves crowd together with hanging catkins. The leaves have not reached full shape, so young. The backlight washes out the outlines, so light, and shape and margin are search. The leaves, not the catkins, are the subject.
Red autumn leaves fill the frame on a branched crown and blend into one mass. No single leaf outline can be traced. I set part to leaf because the leaves are the subject, so leaf_mass applies.
A sunlit cluster of orange and yellow autumn leaves at a branch tip, with green foliage behind. Several leaf outlines can be read, but the leaves overlap. Autumn colour is not a cause.
Red autumn leaves on a branch against a soft conifer background. The leaves are small in the frame and slightly soft, but the lobes can be traced with effort, so shape and margin are search.
Green lobed leaves on a shoot over a busy forest floor, with other leaves overlapping and crowding the frame. The centre leaf outline is readable.
A cluster of ripe pinkish-brown acorns with warty caps on a twig, against a dark soft background. Kind, shape and cap are all easy to read.
Large green lobed leaves fill the frame in even light. The lobes, bristle tips and veins are readable, but many leaves overlap, so alone is false.
A whole small tree in red autumn colour among pines, a scene with no leaf, bark or fruit as the subject, so part is other.
The camera looks steeply up the trunk into the crown. The ridges are visible but strongly foreshortened. This is bark_up_or_dark and angle.
A crown of tulip-tree foliage seen from below, in yellow autumn colour with some green leaves. The leaves overlap into a mass, so no single outline is clear, and the view is from below.
Bark fills the frame with narrow vertical ridges and furrows that repeat. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true.
A leafy branch scene with a few orange-green tulip flowers and a trunk in the background. No leaf, bark or fruit is the main subject, so the part is other.
A whole trunk with fine vertical furrows and lichen patches, shown with both trunk edges. The busy street background (road, car, building, sign) competes with the subject, so alone is false.
A single ripe brown acorn with a scaly cap, hanging from its twig stub against a soft green background. The whole acorn, the cap and how it hangs are all readable.
Four pale dry acorn views on black: a cap from above, a bare nut base, a capped acorn and a bare nut. They are sharp and whole, but the photo does not show how the fruit hangs.
Several green tulip-tree leaves overlap and tilt in different directions. Lobes show on some leaves, but the outlines are crowded and partly hidden, so shape needs a search.

Leaves of a low seedling or sapling seen from above among weeds. Their lobes are irregular and rounded, not the typical tulip-tree outline, so they look young and not fully shaped. The weeds compete with the subject, and I am not sure the form is one the source names for the mature tree.
Green leaves overlap around a twig tip with a flower bud at the centre. Edges and veins are readable, but the full lobed outline is hidden by overlap. The flower bud is a sign of spring.

Close view of furrowed, plated bark with yellow lichen flecks. Warm low sun changes the colour, which makes the true bark colour harder to judge. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.
A grey trunk with long, flat-topped vertical ridges, shown in even light with both trunk edges in the frame. The pattern repeat is wide enough to read.
Two small, newly opened leaves and a folded bud on a twig tip against blue sky. The leaves have not reached full shape, and the view is from below. The point where the stalks join the twig shows.
Three tan acorn views on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar: a capped acorn, a cut nut and a nut base. They are sharp and whole, but the photo does not show how the fruit hangs.
One whole green tulip-tree leaf on a dark background, with a few small spots that do not change the outline. The lobes, notched tip and entire margin are readable.
The tip of a crown seen from below against blue sky, lit by warm low sun. The leaves are small and blend into a mass, and no edge can be traced.
Two open tulip flowers on a twig with large leaves around them. The flowers are the main subject, so the part is other.
Three green, full-shape acorns with scaly caps sit on a twig, so how they sit shows. They are not ripe. Twigs, buds and leaves in the frame compete with the subject.
One whole green tulip-tree leaf with a broad notched tip, held against dark ground with fallen autumn leaves behind it. The outline, entire margin and veins are clear.
A leafy crown with many open tulip flowers and flower buds. The scene is the subject and no single leaf, bark or fruit is, so the part is other.
Five ripe brown acorns with scaly caps on a plain pale background, in different positions. The kind, outline and cap are clear, but the photo does not show how the fruit hangs.
A crown of bare and autumn-coloured twigs with dry seed heads against sky. No leaf, fruit or bark is the main subject.opens as other.

Close, sharp view of deeply ridged bark with a crossing diamond pattern, covered in patches of lichen that make the true colour harder to read. The frame shows only texture, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true.
A whole trunk with both edges in frame, showing sharp vertical ridges with pale furrows. Clear, with a soft background.
A whole tree seen at the base in a forest scene with fallen autumn leaves. The bark is too far away to be the subject, so the part is other.
Frosted dry cones of samaras on bare twigs against a soft blue background. The centre cone is intact and sharp, and it shows how it sits on the twig.

Several trunks in winter, seen from a distance, with twigs and a vine crossing them. Cast shadows and a very dark trunk change the colour, and the fine ridges of the centre trunk are readable only with close study.
Two dry cones on a twig against blurred autumn foliage. They are small in the frame, so the kind, outline and wings are readable only with close study.
A whole tree seen from below, with the trunk running up into a leafy crown. The main subject is the tree as a whole, not the bark, so the part is other.
A single dry cone of samaras on a bare twig against a blue sky and soft background. The outline, the wings and the way it sits on the twig are all visible.
A top view of a splayed cone on snow, with the bare central spike showing and the samaras spread out like a star. The top view hides the usual outline and the way it hangs, so these need close study.
Close, sharp view of deep vertical ridges with yellow-green lichen over much of the surface, which hides the bark colour. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame, so too_close is true.
A dry cone of samaras on a plain dark background, lit by flash, which changes the colour. Only the stalk shows, so how it hangs on the twig needs close study.
Two children in front of a large trunk in a green forest, each holding a small leaf. The main subject is the scene, so the part is other.
A sharp trunk that fills the frame, with both edges visible, showing vertical broken ridges. Pale lichen patches and dappled light make the colour harder to read.
A whole sharp trunk with both edges in frame and a dark background. The ridges and the grey-brown colour are easy to read.
A sharp trunk with both edges in view and a soft sky and foliage behind it. The crossing ridges and furrows are easy to read.
A weathered pale cone lying on the ground among dead grass, debris and clover, in a small image. The clutter competes with it, and the kind and wings need close study.
A dry cone of samaras with the wings spread, on a twig against a soft autumn background. A blurred green leaf at the left edge does not compete with it.
A large, sharp dry cone of samaras on a short twig, against a soft green and yellow background. The wings, the outline and the way it sits on the twig are clear.
A green, tightly closed fruit of full shape on its stalk, among green leaves. It is not ripe, and the samaras are pressed together, so the kind and wings need close study.

Large lobed leaf seen from below, tilted, with the sun coming through it and other leaves in shadow behind. The outline reads, but the edge is in shadow and the leaf is crowded, so margin is search; angle and light make it harder.
Several green leaves overlap on a leafy twig against a dark background. The top-left leaf is whole and its lobes read, but the teeth and the leaf stalks are small and the leaves crowd each other.

A cluster of leaves in autumn colour (green, red, brown) seen from below against the sky, on one stem. The top leaf is whole, the leaves overlap, and the view from below makes the margin harder to read.

Trunk fork seen from below against bare branches and sky. The mottled, peeling patches read clearly, but branches cross the trunk and the view is upward, which is why texture is search. The camera looks up at the trunk, not into the crown.
One bright green leaf seen from above against soft grass. Lobes, teeth and veins read clearly. A twig with stalks shows only at the top, so arrangement is search.
A large green leaf in the middle of the frame, on a soft grass background. Outline, teeth and veins read well. Part of a second leaf is cut by the left edge, but the main leaf is whole.

Two pale-green leaves, shown from below, held in front of a trunk with peeling bark; a hand at the right edge gives scale. The outline of the right leaf is clear. The margin is dull and low-contrast, and the bark and leaf litter compete in the frame.
Green leaf lit by flash against a black night background, with small brown spots that do not change the outline. Flash changes the colour (light). Twig and stalks show only at the top.
A dry, opened cone of samaras sitting upright on a bare twig against snow. Kind, outline, wings and the way it sits on the twig all read. Most seeds have fallen, so it is not the ripe look.
Close-up of mottled green, grey, cream and orange peeling bark with a clear patchwork pattern. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame, so it is texture only.
A street tree trunk seen from a distance, with a car, a curb and grass in the frame. The patchy bark is small and dark, so texture and pattern need a search; the scene competes with the trunk.

Bare branches against a blue sky, seen from below, with small dry seed cones on the twigs. The cones are tiny in the frame among many branches, so kind, shape and wings take a search. How the cones sit on the twigs shows.

A large green leaf in the middle, with toothed lobes and clear veins, in a crowd of other leaves. A small fruit head hangs near the top but does not replace the leaf. Only tiny holes mark the leaf; the outline is intact.
A leafy sapling with a tree behind it. The leaves overlap and blend into a mass, and no single leaf shows its margin.
A bare winter tree seen from below, with the trunk and the crown cropped by the frame. The main subject is the whole tree, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
A scene of a forked trunk with a hollow and heavy undergrowth in summer. The main subject is the whole tree in its setting, not one part.
A cut leafy stem laid on pale grey boards, with several dark green leaves. Lobes, teeth, veins and the stalks joining the stem all read. The frame cuts off the bottom and left leaves.
A trunk with peeling, mottled grey, cream and brown bark, with branches crossing it and a soft grass background. The pattern and the surface read clearly. The photo has a warm cast but is not sepia.
A dull grey-green leaf seen from below, with dark specks, in dim shade with other leaves overlapping it. The overlap and the low light make the lobes and teeth harder to trace.
A pale yellow-green leaf with mottled stippling, seen from above against soft gravel. Lobes, teeth and veins read clearly, and the outline is intact. The stalk and twig show only at the top.

Close view of a green, full-shape spiky seed ball on a stalk against a leaf. It is not ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look false. The stalk runs out of the frame, so how it hangs on the twig needs a search.

Large green mature leaf, underside, held in a hand, with other leaves behind it. The frame edge cuts off the right lobe and the leaf has a hole, a gall-like spot and a brown patch, so it is damaged. The twig is not shown, so arrangement is no.
Leafless tree with pale mottled trunk and limbs, seen from below against the sky. The main subject is the whole tree, so the part is other. The upward view is an angle cause.
Many small brown seed balls on bare twigs against the sky. Each ball is tiny in the frame and the twigs compete with it, so kind, shape and hang need a search.
Ripe brown seed balls on long stalks hang from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. The balls, the stalks and the hang are all easy to read.
Close view of mottled flaking bark in grey, green and cream plates with a knot. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true.

A broken seed ball lying on a log, seen from above, with the honeycomb pits left after the seeds fell and a second ball behind it. This is a broken fruit ball and a top view, so atypical and angle. The kind needs close study and the hang is not shown.
Base of a dark trunk beside a kerb and a car, seen from a distance. The bark texture and the plate pattern are small in the frame, so both are search. The kerb and car give scale.
Small young seed ball hanging from a twig with new leaf growth and a soft green background. The ball has not reached full size, so young. Spring is shown by the new shoots.
Trunk filling the frame with the camouflage pattern of pale and olive patches, with leaves at the edges and trunk edges visible. The pattern and texture can be read.
Row of leafy trees along a paved path, a street scene. The source name Platanus x hispanica matches the tree, so there is no hybrid reject. The part is other.
Full-size yellow-green spiky seed ball on a stalk joined to a twig, against a soft sky and branches. It is not yet ripe brown, so unripe.
Small green seed ball hanging on a stalk, with yellow autumn leaves blurred behind. The twig is not shown, so how it hangs on the twig needs a search. The ball is green, so unripe.
Whole tree seen from below, with pale peeling trunk, branches and green crown cut by the frame. The main subject is the tree, so the part is other, and the upward view is an angle cause.

Broken seed ball seen end-on on a log, with a dark core and a ring of seed fluff. It is not the typical ball form and the view is unusual, so atypical and angle. A learner needs close study to see the kind and outline.
Many ripe brown seed balls hang on stalks from bare twigs against a plain blue sky. The balls and the hang are clear, and the sky keeps the frame uncluttered.

Seed ball breaking apart, with seed fluff bursting out of the hollow centre, in front of a soft background. This is a broken ball form, so atypical. The ball is readable, but the twig is not shown, so the hang is search.
Small green seed ball on a long stalk hanging from a bare twig, with a soft background. The stalk and the way it hangs are clear. The ball is green, so unripe.
Trunk with peeling brown and cream plates against a woodland background, with the trunk edges in view. The peeling pattern is easy to read.
Large ripe brown spiky seed ball in sharp focus, with a soft background. Only a short stalk shows at the top, so how it hangs on the twig is search.

Overlapping green plane leaves on a branch, with a small seed ball at the lower right and a car and street behind. The lobed outline can be traced on the large centre leaf, but the leaves crowd each other, so shape and margin need close study.
Trunk of a plane with grey-green, cream and brown flaking plates, both trunk edges in frame. The small file is sharp and the plate pattern reads clearly.

Crowded bright green leaves against sky and wires, with a trunk at the right. The leaves are backlit and overlap, so a learner has to study them to read outline and edge; the bright backlight is the light cause.
Tall view of a trunk with cream, olive and brown flaking plates, with sky and trees behind. Both edges of the trunk show and the mottled pattern is easy to read.
Close view of rough, plated bark with no trunk edge in frame. The right half is in deep shadow, which hides the colour and makes the plate pattern harder to read, but the texture is still readable.
Trunk with cream and brown peeling plates against a pale building and a leafy edge at the top left. Trunk edges show and the mottling reads well in the small file.
Close-up of green, yellow and brown camouflage-like patches on smooth exfoliating bark. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
A brown dead fallen leaf lying on grass among other dead leaves. The subject is a dead leaf, so it is a reject.
View looking up a forked, knobbly dark trunk into bare branches against the sky. The camera looks up and the trunk is in shade, so the bark is hard to read.
Wide area of trunk with cream, grey and olive patches, both edges in frame and soft green foliage behind. The blotchy flaking pattern is clear.
Close view of cream and rust-brown peeling plates in warm low sun with a long shadow. The warm light shifts the colour, and the frame has no trunk edge or scale object.
A dark green lobed leaf with toothed edges in front of a trunk, with a hand holding another leaf at the top. The right lobes run off the frame edge, so the outline is not whole.
A street scene with a row of plane trees, cyclists and traffic. The main subject is the scene, not a leaf, bark or fruit.

Several small green seed balls hanging on thin stalks among leaves, seen from below against blue sky. The balls are small in the frame and leaves compete, and I cannot clearly see two balls on one stalk. The balls are green and not ripe.
A pale green leaf held in a hand, showing its toothed, lobed edge and veins. The fingers cover the lower left part, so the leaf is not whole; the hand gives scale.
A dense mass of bright yellow-green foliage crossed by one branch. The leaves blend into a mass with no single leaf outline, and the bright sun washes out the colour.
A sharp green leaf with pointed lobes and toothed edges against a dark soft background. The other leaves at the left and bottom stay quiet, and the stalk shows only a little of the join to the twig.
A small group of overlapping green leaves in front of a blotchy trunk, in a grainy, soft photo. The leaf outlines can be traced, but the edge and veins need close study.
Whole width of a pale trunk covered in a fine network of dark cracks between small plates, with palm leaves behind. Trunk edges show and the pattern reads clearly.

Trunk with olive, pink and brown patches covered in grey-green lichen, with fallen leaves and a street behind. The lichen hides the plate pattern and the true bark colour, so a learner has to study it.
A brown spiky seed ball held in a hand against soft leaf litter. The ball outline and spiky surface read clearly. The hand hides how it hangs, and only one ball shows.
Two golden-brown seed balls hang one below the other on one stalk against a soft blue sky. Sharp, and the hang shows well.

A small green spiky seed ball dangles from a stalk that a hand holds, with leaves and fingers around it. The ball is small in the frame, so kind and shape need close study. It is green and unripe, and the hand hides how it hangs.
A seed ball that is breaking up on paving stones, seen from above, with loose seed hairs beside it. The ball is atypical and the top view is unusual, so the kind takes close study.
A green spiky seed ball hangs on a long stalk among sharp leaves that crowd the frame. The ball is full-shaped but green, so unripe. Only one ball shows.
A green seed ball hangs on a thin stalk against a soft dark green background. Slightly soft, but the outline and spikes read. Green, so unripe; only one ball.
Two pale green seed balls hang one below the other on one stalk that runs down from a leaf, with a third ball partly hidden behind the top one. Green, so unripe.
A dense mass of crown leaves with a few tiny seed balls lost in the foliage. No single leaf or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
An autumn scene of a trunk and brown leaves in low warm sun, with one small green ball low in the frame. The scene is the main subject, so the part is other.
A dark brown seed ball seen from below against bright leaves, so it is backlit and looks almost black. The round shape and the hang show, but the spiky surface is hard to read. Only one ball.
Brown seed balls hang on stalks against plain blue sky, seen from below. The balls are sharp and read well, but the balls hang on separate stalks, not two on one.
Crowded cluster of red, orange and green autumn leaves on a shrub. The leaves overlap and none is a whole leaf in frame, so the outline and lobe tips need close study. Autumn colour is not a cause.
Summer green leaves in a dense crown view. Several leaves are lobed and clear, but they overlap, and the serrated margin is small in frame.
Dense sprig of yellow, orange and red autumn leaves. A central leaf shows its lobes, but the leaves overlap and the margin is small. Autumn colour is not a cause.

A whole mature tree in woodland, with a bare crown and moss on the lower trunk. It is a whole-tree photo, not a leaf, bark or fruit close-up. The bare crown sets the season as winter, though the grass is green.
Yellow autumn leaves fill the left half of a landscape with a red tree and sky behind. The leaves are small in frame, so the outline and margin need study. Autumn colour is not a cause.

Red and green autumn leaves on a branch, with purple aster flowers in the lower corner. One large leaf has clear lobes, but the frame cuts it and other leaves compete with it. The flowers do not take the place of the leaf feature.
One full green leaf with a red stalk on a soft, dark background. The lobes, margin and blade all show clearly.
A grey trunk with lichen patches, seen from a few metres in woodland. The trunk edges are visible and the background is soft. The ridges show only at a distance, so texture and pattern need a search.
A forked trunk with a hollow wound in the middle stem. The middle stem is in shade against a bright sky, and the ridges read only at a distance. The hollow changes the trunk outline.
A close bark surface of grey-brown plates and ridges with lichen. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object in frame, so too_close is true.
A red maple-type leaf lying on leaf litter among brown dead leaves. The lobed outline is clear, but the leaf has fallen and is dead tissue, so dead_leaf is yes. The litter competes with it.
Close view of a ridged, plated trunk with a hand pointing at the bark. The hand covers part of the bark, so whole is false. The trunk edge at the top right is visible.
Close texture of grey bark with ridges and lichen. No trunk edge, branch or scale object shows, so too_close is true. The pattern is clear.
A tall, straight grey trunk with deep vertical fissures and plates. Both trunk edges are visible and the ferns in the background are soft.
One sunlit autumn leaf on a twig, with its lobes and toothed margin showing. The leaf is whole and the pine background is soft. Autumn colour is not a cause.
The camera looks up along a trunk into the crown, with a birdhouse on the bark and a sun flare. The backlight washes the texture, which is small in frame. The trunk edges are visible.
Backlit orange-brown autumn leaves, mostly out of focus. A few leaves are in focus, but their edges need a search to trace, and the crowd competes with them. The warm backlight changes the colour.
A large red-green autumn leaf fills the frame, with the lobes and margin sharp. The left lobe runs off the frame edge, so whole is false. The colour is autumn change, not a cause.
Reddish-brown bark with plates and pale patches, filling the frame. A small twig crosses the top left and a green leaf sits at the right edge, so too_close is false.
A carpet of fallen red, pink and brown leaves on the ground. The leaves overlap and are dead, so dead_leaf is yes. A few lobed outlines show, but none is a clear whole leaf.
Dry tan samaras hang in a crowd of leaves and a tree crown with buildings behind, so the shape is small in the frame and needs a search. The samara kind reads clearly. Full leaves point to summer.
Close view of pink-green samaras with full wing shape, clear against a soft green background. The pink colour shows the fruit is not yet ripe, so it is not the usual look.
Red samaras hang from bare twigs against a plain blue sky, with full wing outlines. Red colour and bare branches mark spring and an unripe fruit.
A cluster of pink-red samaras with clear wing outlines in front of a soft background. Pink colour marks an unripe fruit in spring.
Pinkish samaras hang on red stems against blue sky and blurred twigs. The wings are readable and the fruit still has a pink tinge, so it is not yet ripe.
Close view of grey-brown bark with ridges, plates and grooves all readable. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close is true. No cause makes it harder.
Pink-brown samaras hang from red stems in front of soft green bokeh. Wings are clear. The pink tint marks the fruit as not yet ripe.

Whole trunk seen from a distance over grass, with the trunk edges visible. The bark ridges show only at search distance, so texture and pattern are search. Not too close, since the trunk edge is in frame.

One whole leaf on a dark background. Lobes and margin are readable. The pale silvery colour suggests the underside lit by flash or backlight, which is the light cause. Trusted source name is Acer saccharum.
Small red-green samaras are still forming on yellow-green stems in front of soft bokeh. Their size and early shape mean the kind and shape need a search. The fruit has not reached its full shape.
Whole green leaf on a plain black background with the lobes and margin clearly visible. A mature, typical leaf in summer colour.
Whole mature leaf lying on wood chips. The lobes and margin are clear. The busy mulch behind it competes, and the cool shadow gives a blue-green cast, which is the light cause.

Orange-red samaras in clusters on bare twigs against a black background. The flash-lit warm colour on the dark background is the light cause. Wings are clear, and the fruit is still red, so it is not yet ripe.
Pinkish-brown samaras hang on red stems against soft green bokeh, with wings clearly outlined. The pink tone marks the fruit as not yet ripe.
Close view of grey-brown bark with plates and ridges, all readable. No trunk edge, branch or scale is in frame, so too_close is true.
A tree crown in autumn colour, orange and yellow leaves filling the frame. Main subject is a crown, so part is other. Autumn colour is not a cause, but it makes the look not usual.
Lobed green leaf in front is whole and its outline is clear. Other leaves on the branch compete, and the margin needs a search. A small brown patch on one leaf does not change the outline.
Many red-pink samaras hang from bare twigs in front of a busy pine background. The clusters compete, and the outline of each small samara needs a search. The red colour marks the fruit as unripe.
Red flowers hang on long stalks from a branch, and no fruit or leaf shows. Flowers take the place of the feature, so the photo is rejected as buds or flowers.
Fallen leaves lie in a pile on the ground, overlapping and mottled with brown spots. The central leaf is partly covered, so it is not whole. The leaves are dead and fallen, so dead_leaf applies.

Crowded foliage: the left maple leaf is whole and its lobes read, but the margin is small in the frame and needs study. The main veins are visible; no stalk joins to the twig and there is no scale object.
A tall trunk with vertical ridges and furrows fills the frame, with a soft background. The trunk edges show, so it is not a close texture-only view.
Broad rough plates on a trunk that fills the frame, with trunk edges visible. A sharp brick building beside the trunk competes with it for attention.
One whole, flat, green five-lobed maple leaf on a plain background. Lobes, toothed margin and palmate veins all read clearly; no stalk joins a twig and there is no scale object.
The camera looks steeply up into the crown, so the trunk is small in the frame and the bark plates need close study. The branches and sky compete with the trunk.
Shaggy vertical plates fill a sunlit trunk with a warm orange cast from low sun. A sharp brick building on the left competes with the trunk.
A small sapling in a garden shows leaves that blend into a mass with the hosta and fence behind. No single leaf margin can be seen at this size, so the margin is not shown.
A sapling in a garden bed, with its leaves blending into a crown mass against evergreens and hosta. The leaf margins are not visible and no single leaf is shown whole.
A cluster of paired samaras hangs from a twig with leaves beside them on a black background. The samara kind and hang read clearly; the wing outline is small and overlapped, so it needs study.
A crown of orange autumn foliage. The leaves blend into a mass, and the margins and veins are too small to read. The orange colour is autumn colour, not a cause.
A large old trunk with deep plates and moss fills the frame, with a soft background of foliage and sky. The trunk edges show, so the frame is not texture-only.
Grey-brown vertical ridges and plates on a trunk with its edges in frame. A building doorway and sidewalk at the right compete with the trunk.
A grey trunk with a fork and lichen patches in winter light, with bare trees and blue sky behind. Lichen covers part of the ridge pattern, so the pattern needs study.
A close view of shaggy reddish-brown plates with no trunk edge, branch, or scale in the frame. Warm low light gives the bark a reddish cast, which is a light cause and not a filter.
A multi-stemmed trunk seen from a distance, with woodland and autumn foliage behind. The bark texture is small in the frame and needs close study, so it is a search and not a reject.
A single dry, golden samara pair lies flat on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar. The wings and kind read clearly; the photo does not show how the fruit hangs from a twig.
A close view of grey bark with ridges and fissures and some lichen, with no trunk edge or scale in the frame. The pattern repeats across the frame and reads clearly.
A close, evenly lit view of grey bark with vertical ridges and furrows, with no trunk edge, branch or scale. The texture and pattern read clearly.
A grey-brown trunk with green lichen patches that partly hide the ridge pattern, against a soft green background. The trunk edges show, so it is not texture-only.
A pile of fallen, dry autumn leaves on the ground, lit by warm low sun. The leaves are dead, and their margins cannot be read in the pile.
One dry samara lying on snow, with the wing and stalk plainly visible. It is not on the twig, so hang is no; the source name Acer saccharum matches the tree.
A full trunk in even daylight, with blocky ridges and plates clear across the frame and both trunk edges in view. The bark is the typical mature pattern for the source name Quercus alba.
A branch of lobed leaves with the centre leaf whole and tilted, so angle is yes, and other leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false. The lobes read clearly, but the margin needs close study.
A close view of a glaucous, lobed leaf, probably the underside, against a dark soft background. The frame cuts off the base and the lower lobes, so whole is false.
Green acorns on a branch, full size but unripe, so usual_look is false. The acorns are small in a crowd of leaves, so shape, cap and hang need a close look.
A sunlit crown or sapling of lobed leaves over a lawn, with the leaves merging into a mass. The margin cannot be made out at this size, and strong sun and shadow change the colour.
Dry brown samaras hanging from a bare twig, with the wings clear. Backlight from the bright sky warms the colour, so light is yes.
Two ripe acorns on a plain blue backdrop with a 1 cm scale bar, the nut and scaly cup both clear. They are laid on the backdrop, not on a twig, so hang is no.
Silvery lobed leaves in a crowd, with water on them, probably showing their undersides. The leaves are crowded, so the outlines and veins need close study, but none is missing.
Green acorns hanging on stalks from a branch of oak leaves, the cups clear. The acorns are full size but still green, so growth is unripe and usual_look is false.
A dark trunk with flaky ridges that read clearly, with both trunk edges in view. Part of the trunk is in shadow and the sun is patchy, so the colour is changed and light is yes.
A trunk in woodland with blocky plates clear across it and both edges in view. The forest background is soft and does not compete with the trunk.
A grey trunk with vertical ridges and plates read clearly in even light, with both trunk edges in view. The brick building behind is soft.
A forked trunk and crown seen from below against a bright sky, with the top cut off by the frame. The subject is a whole tree, so part is other, and the backlight and the view from below are harder.
Green samaras with pale wings hanging in a cluster, sharp and in clear light. The green bodies show they are not yet ripe, so usual_look is false.
One lobed leaf with holes near the edge and small galls on the blade. The holes change the outline a little, so damaged is yes, but the lobes and veins still read clearly.
A green acorn with a scaly cup on a lobed oak leaf, the shape clear. The acorn is green and not yet ripe, so usual_look is false; the stalk is not visible, so hang is no.
Green samaras hanging in a cluster on a black background, with the wings and hang clear. The bodies are still green, so growth is unripe and usual_look is false.
A cluster of silvery lobed leaves whose stalks join at one node, so arrangement is clear. Other leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false, and the pale colour suggests the underside.
A grey-brown trunk with ridges and plates clear across the frame, with both trunk edges in view. The campus background is soft.
One green acorn with its scaled cup shows in full and sharp, with leaves blurred behind. It has full shape but is green, so it is unripe and not the usual look.
A pile of brown fallen leaves on the ground. The leaves are dead and brown, and their lobes overlap, so shape and margin need close study.
A cluster of green acorns with cups on a twig, with large leaves in front. The acorns overlap and the leaves compete, so the outline needs search. The acorns are unripe.
One whole, sharp, mature green leaf with bristle-tipped lobes, sunlit against a soft background. Nothing makes it harder.
Grey ridged bark at the base of a trunk, with the trunk edge and flare in frame and a soft park background. The ridges and plates read clearly.
Bright lime-green spring leaves with catkins on a sprig, backlit by the sun and set against a soft trunk. The new leaves are young and the backlight changes the colour.
A dark trunk photographed from below, with the camera looking up into the crown and the trunk in shade. The texture is hard to read at this darkness and angle.
Several green mature leaves on a branch, with lobes and edges readable and a path blurred behind. The crowded leaves make it not alone, but the features are clear.
Three green acorns with cups on a twig, with leaves around them. The acorns are full shape but green, so they are unripe.
A small shoot with several leaves growing out from the bark of a trunk, with moss below. The stalks join at one point on the trunk, which marks a sucker shoot, so the leaves are rejected.
A sprig of pale green lobed leaves seen from above over soft leaf litter. The leaf outlines read, and the edges need close study at this size.
Pale yellow-green spring leaves with catkins, backlit in sun against soft gravestones and trees. The new leaves are young and the backlight changes the colour.
A dense crown of red autumn leaves on branches. The leaves blend into a mass, and the margin of single leaves cannot be read.
A shoot of yellow-orange autumn leaves with lobes in a busy green background. The autumn colour is not a cause, and the edges need close study.
A branch of red autumn leaves with lobes readable, set against a soft conifer background. The colour is autumn colour and is not a cause.
Large green mature leaves on the forest floor with lobed edges readable. A few small holes sit inside the blade and do not change the outline. Other leaves crowd the frame.
Mature maroon-brown acorns with cups, sharp against a dark background. Their shape and cup are clear and they are ripe.
Green mature lobed leaves hang in front of a trunk, with a whole leaf readable at centre. Other leaves crowd the frame, but the lobes are clear.
A branch of small red autumn leaves against a dark conifer background. The leaves are crowded and small in frame, so lobes and edges need search. The red colour is autumn colour.
A tall grey trunk photographed from below, with the camera looking up into the crown. The ridges read clearly, but the upward view is a reject.

Looking up into a Liriodendron crown with autumn yellow and green leaves against pale sky. Part is other, so no features are scored; leaf_mass because the photo shows a crown. Angle is yes (view from below); autumn colour is not a cause.
Close view of fine vertical ridges in grey-brown bark filling the frame, with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close is true. Texture, pattern and colour all read clearly on mature bark.
A crown with several open tulip-type flowers among green leaves. Flowers are the main subject, so buds_or_flowers; the crown is also a leaf_mass case. Flowers are the spring sign.

Trunk seen from standing distance, with grey-green lichen over much of the ridges and a busy street and building behind. Pattern and texture are search because of distance and lichen, which is a search case, not a reject; alone is false because of the background.
One acorn hanging from its twig, with a scaled cap and brown nut against a soft green background. Kind, shape, hang and cap all read clearly, and the acorn is ripe.

Four acorn views on a plain black background: the cap from above, an acorn with cap, a nut from the side and one from the end. The central acorn is typical and clear. The top view of the cap is an angle cause; no reject.

Crowded mature green leaves with a small green bud in the centre; several tulip-type lobes show but overlap and the front leaf is cut by the frame. Shape, margin, venation and arrangement are search because of crowding, so no reject.

A low, sprawling plant in undergrowth with mitten-like and lobed leaves. The source names Liriodendron and I trust it; the mitten form is not one the source names for the mature tree, so it is rejected. The photo does not show the shoot origin, so sucker_leaf is the closest code and the owner should check it.
Crowded mature green leaves with a green flower bud at the centre and sunlight through gaps. Shape, margin and venation are search because the leaves overlap, which is a search case, not a reject.

Close view of deep, plated, vertical-ridged bark with yellow-green lichen flecks, filling the frame with no trunk edge, so too_close. Texture and pattern read clearly; the warm low-sun tint is a light cause, not a reject.
Trunk of grey vertical-ridged bark with its edges visible against soft green foliage. Texture, pattern and colour read clearly, and the bark is mature.
Two young unfolded leaves and a green bud at the tip of a twig against blue sky. The leaves have not reached full shape, so young; shape and margin are search, and the stalks join the twig.

Specimen photo on a blue backdrop with a 1 cm scale bar: a whole acorn with cap, a cut acorn and a top view. The main acorn is typical and ripe. The top view is an angle cause; the backdrop is a studio backdrop, not a tint, so no quality escalation.
Single full, mature green Liriodendron-type leaf with notched tip, outline, margin and veins clear, on dark bark. The small red spots do not change the outline, so they are not a damage cause.
Crown of small green leaves seen from below against a blue sky. Part is other; leaf_mass because the leaves form a crown; angle because the view is from below.
Two open flowers and buds on a twig among green leaves, with a soft green background. Flowers are the main subject, so part is other and buds_or_flowers is a reject. Flowers are the spring sign.
Green acorns on a branch among oak-like lobed leaves. They have full acorn shape but are still green, so unripe and usual_look false; the kind, shape, hang and cap all read clearly.
One full green Liriodendron-type leaf lying on dark leaf litter, with outline, margin and veins clear. The autumn litter sets the season; the leaf itself is green and mature.
Crown of green leaves with several open tulip-type flowers. Part is other; the flowers are the main subject and the crown is a leaf_mass case.
Five brown ripe acorns on a grey background with caps and stalks visible; the central acorn is typical and clear. They lie on a surface, not a twig, so hang is no.
A crown of tulip-tree branches with yellowing leaves and seed heads against an overcast sky, cut off at the frame edges. No single leaf, bark area or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
A close view of a deeply furrowed trunk with interlacing diagonal ridges and lichen patches, with no trunk edge or branch in frame, so too_close is true. The ridges are sharp and readable.
A full trunk with both edges in frame, vertical ridges and furrows clearly readable in even light. The park behind is soft and does not compete with the trunk.
A whole mature tree in woodland with its top cut off by the frame, autumn leaves on the ground, and the lower trunk in deep shade. No leaf, bark area or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
Several dried, frosted seed cones sit upright on bare twigs against a blurred blue background. The cone outline reads clearly, but the kind of fruit needs close study, so kind is search.

Pale trunks in a bare winter wood, seen from a distance, with a dark trunk and shrubs beside them. The ridges are readable only with close study, so texture and pattern are search, and the trunks compete with each other, so alone is false.
Two dried, cupped pods sit on a twig in front of soft autumn foliage. The cup outline reads clearly, but what kind of fruit they are needs close study, so kind is search.
The camera looks up the trunk into a broad green crown, so the bark is seen from below and the canopy takes most of the frame. The trunk edge and branches are in frame, so too_close is false.
One dried, cupped seed cone sits on a bare twig against a blue sky. The outline and the way it sits on the twig are clear, but the kind of cone needs close study.
A dried, spent seed cone seen from directly above on a pale background, with a short stalk at the left. The top view hides how it sits, so hang is no, and its radial outline and kind need study.
A close view of a trunk with deep vertical furrows and yellow-green lichen, with no trunk edge or branch in frame, so too_close is true. The ridges are sharp and the photo is not dark or blurred.
A dried, upright seed cone with pointed bracts against a dark background. Its stalk is cut off below, so hang is no, and the kind of cone needs close study.
Two children stand beside a large trunk in green woodland, and they take most of the frame. The trunk is behind them and is not the subject, so the part is other.
A trunk fills the frame with fine vertical ridges and pale lichen flecks in even shade, with no trunk edge in frame, so too_close is true. The texture reads clearly.
A tall trunk with both edges in frame and rough vertical ridges clearly readable, set against a dark conifer background. The trunk is not too dark to read.
A tall trunk with both edges in frame, with diagonal ridges and plates clearly readable under bright sky. Leafy branches at the edge do not compete with it.

A dried, fallen seed cone lies in leaf litter with clover and dead leaves around it. The whole outline is clear, but the kind needs close study, the litter competes, and it does not sit on a twig, so hang is no.
A dried seed cone sits on a thin stalk against a soft lawn and autumn trees, with a tulip-tree leaf in front at the left. The cone and its stalk are clear, but the kind needs close study.
A dried, brown seed cone on a short twig against blurred green foliage. The outline and bracts are clear, but the kind of cone needs close study.
A green cone of full shape sits on a short stalk among green leaves, and its outline is clear. It is not yet ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false, and its kind needs close study.
Sunlit, glossy, mature Platanus leaf with clear lobes, teeth and veins. The lower lobe runs into the frame edge and other leaves crowd the background, and the stalk joins the twig only partly.

Several mature lobed leaves on a sunlit branch, with a whole leaf outline at the centre right. The leaves crowd each other and a small yellow-green bud sits among them, but it does not hide any leaf feature.

Red-tinted new flush leaves on a young tree, mixed with a few full green leaves against the sky. The top-right leaf shows its lobes, but the margin and veins need a close look, and the young leaves make the photo harder.
Pale mottled plates and flaking on a trunk with a branch crossing it, against a plain blue sky. The trunk edge and branches are in frame, so this is not a texture-only view.
A large, full-green lobed leaf with toothed margin and clear veins, set against soft grass. A second leaf at the edge is partly out of the frame, and the stalk joins the twig only partly.
A close, bright, full-green lobed leaf with a toothed margin and clear veins over a grass background. The stalk joins a twig only partly in view.
A hand holds a lobed mature leaf in front of bark, with the outline and veins clear and the hand giving the scale. Other leaves and bark behind compete, and the hand is not a fault.

A flash-lit green leaf on a black background, with its lobed outline clear and the margin and veins readable only with a close look. Brown browned leaves at the top left are in the frame, but the subject is green.
A dried Tulip-tree seed cone on snow, with the samaras gone and only the open carpels left, so the kind of fruit does not show. The outline reads and the fruit sits on its stalk.
A close view of olive and cream bark plates with rust-red inner patches. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, and the plates and colour read at once.
The trunk base seen from the kerb, with cars and a road in the frame. The pale grey and brown bark shows only at a distance, so the texture and pattern need a search.

A bare winter crown of Tulip-tree branches against a clear blue sky, with small dark seed clusters on the twigs. The main subject is the branch network, so the part is other and no part check applies.
Three or more mature lobed leaves on a sunlit twig, with a pale fuzzy bud or flower head in the middle. The bud does not take the place of any leaf feature, and the stalks join the twig only partly.
A whole young tree in full leaf, seen against other trees. The leaves blend into a crown mass, so the outline and margin of one leaf cannot be learned at this size.
A bare winter crown photographed from below, with the branches against a plain blue sky. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other and no bark check applies.

A multi-stem trunk of an old tree with a hollow at its base and pale flaking bark, seen at a distance in green undergrowth. The hollow changes the trunk outline, and the texture and pattern need a close look.
Several cut mature lobed leaves on a twig laid on a white deck. The lobes, margins and veins read, and the stalks join the twig in view, though the leaves compete with each other.
Flaking grey-green plates on a trunk, with a branch crossing above it and dry grass behind. The trunk edge and a branch are in frame, so it is not a texture-only view.
A lobed mature leaf with small brown spots against a soft dark background, with browned leaves beside it. The outline and veins read, and the margin needs a close look.
A single whole lobed leaf on gravel in bright light, with the outline, lobes and veins clear. The stalk joins a twig at the top only partly in view.
A green, unripe seed ball on a stalk in front of a leaf. Kind and round shape read clearly; the stalk's join to the twig is out of frame, so hang is at search.

Mature green plane leaf held in a hand, upper side. The lobes and coarse teeth read clearly, but the hand covers the left lobe and the bottom lobe runs off the frame, so whole is false. Small holes and brown spots do not change the outline.

A winter crown of bare branches seen from below against blue sky, with a pale trunk. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other and no key feature is tested. The camera looks up into the crown, which a bark photo would be rejected for, but the part is not bark.
A wide winter crown with many small seed balls scattered over bare branches against blue sky. The fruit are too small to be the subject, so the part is other.
Five brown seed balls hang on stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. The balls are small in the frame, so kind is at search; the round outline and the hang read clearly.
Close-up of mottled grey, cream, and teal bark plates with flaking. The frame shows no trunk edge, branch, or scale, so too_close is true.

Trunk base with flaring roots on a street lawn, with a red car at the edge. The bark pattern shows only at a distance, so texture and pattern are at search, and alone is false because the car competes.
A small, green, spiky seed ball hangs on a stalk from a twig with red-tipped buds and a new leaf. The ball has not reached its full size, so it is young; the stalk and bud signs point to spring.
Mature pale trunk with a plate and crack pattern and a dark knot. Yellow flowers at the foot and leaves at the top are not the subject. Trunk edges are in frame, so too_close is false.
A tree-lined path under a full green canopy. It is a scene, so the part is other and no key feature is tested.

One yellow-green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a bare twig against blue sky. The ball is whole and reads clearly, and it is still green, so it is unripe. Only one ball shows, so two_heads is no.
A yellow-green seed ball hangs on a stalk in front of autumn leaves. It has full shape but is still green, so it is unripe and usual_look is false. The autumn colour is in the background only.
Mature trunk in woodland with peeling flakes and plates. Trunk edges show, so too_close is false.
A dried, spiky seed ball lies on a log, with a second dark ball behind it that competes for attention. Kind and round shape read clearly. The ball sits on wood, not on a twig, so hang is no.
A pale trunk photographed from the ground with the camera tilted up into the crown. The camera looks up into the crown, so bark_up_or_dark is yes. Texture and pattern show only at a distance.

A dried seed ball on a log with its spiky outer layer torn away, so the hairs spread in a star around a central core. The torn form is atypical and the tears change the outline, so outline is not tested. Kind is at search because the surface is worn.
Several orange-brown seed balls hang from bare branches against blue sky. The balls are small in the frame and compete with each other, so kind is at search and alone is false.
A dried, brown, spiky seed ball hangs from a stalk against a pale, blurred background. The form is whole and typical, and kind and shape read clearly.
A green, spiky seed ball hangs from a thin stalk on a twig with red-tipped buds, against a blurred background. It is full-sized but still green, so it is unripe. The red bud tips point to spring.
A brown, dense, spiky seed ball hangs from a stalk, lit by sun against a dark, soft background. It is whole and typical, so it is ripe.

A branch of green plane leaves in a street scene with a parked car. The leaves are small in the frame and crowd each other, so shape and margin need a close look. One green seed ball hangs at the right; the photo is about the leaves.
Close view of plane bark with peeling cream, grey and brown plates. The frame shows bark only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
Several green plane leaves with lobes and visible main veins, with a trunk at the right. The leaves overlap, so the photo is not alone. Bright sky behind the leaves gives some backlight.
Close view of plane bark with cream and brown plates, lit by warm low sun that warms the colour. Plates and ridges are clear. No trunk edge is shown.
Dark, shadowed plane bark in deep shade. The plate texture reads, but the pattern and colour need close study. No trunk edge is shown.
Vertical trunk with cream and brown plates, with both trunk edges and a pale wall behind. A few leaves at the top-left sit in the background. The bark pattern is clear.

Close view of plates with saturated green, yellow and rust tones. The colours look heavily saturated or filtered, so the tree may not look real. The plate pattern itself is clear. No trunk edge is shown.
A single brown, dead plane leaf lying on grass among other dead leaves. The outline is clear, but the subject is dead and brown, so it is not the usual look.
Trunk photographed from below, looking up into bare branches against a bright sky. The camera looks up into the crown, and the backlit bark is dim, so texture and pattern need close study.
Trunk with grey-white, cream and green plate patches. Both trunk edges and a forest background show. The plates and ridges read clearly.
Close view of cream and rust-brown plates under warm low sun, which warms the colour. The plate pattern is clear. No trunk edge is shown.
A dark green lobed plane leaf held in front of a pale trunk, with fingers at the top-left. The leaf runs to the right frame edge, so its outline is cut off. The lobes and main veins are clear.
A street scene of a row of whole plane trees with cyclists and traffic. The crowns blend into a green mass, and no single leaf, bark area or fruit is the subject.
Several whole green seed balls hang on thin stalks against a plain blue sky. The balls are full-shaped but still green, so they are unripe. Two balls on one stalk would need a close look.
A whole green lobed plane leaf held in a hand, against a dark plain background. The hand gives the scale. The outline, toothed margin and veins are all clear.
A dense mass of overlapping green leaves with a twig running across the frame. The leaves blend together, so no single leaf outline reads well.

A whole pale-green lobed leaf on a dark soft background, with a small bud at its stalk base that suggests spring new growth. The lobes and veins are clear. The photo does not show whether the leaf comes from a sucker shoot.
A central lobed leaf in front of a soft pale trunk. The photo is slightly soft, so the toothed margin and veins need close study. The central leaf outline is whole.
Pale grey-cream bark with fine plates and wrinkles, in full daylight. The trunk edges show at both sides against green foliage. The plate pattern is clear.
Trunk covered in green-grey lichen with pale plates showing through. The lichen hides part of the plate pattern, so texture and pattern need close study. A trunk edge shows at the right.
A dried brown seed ball held in a hand, whole and sharp, against leaf litter. Kind and shape are clear. The hand holds it, so hang is no, and only one ball shows, so two_heads is no.
Two dried seed balls hang on one stalk from a bare winter branch against a plain blue sky. Both are whole and sharp. All four fruit features are clear.
A full-size but green seed ball held in a hand, on a short stalk to a leafy twig. Green means unripe, so usual_look is false. Held in hand, so hang is no. One ball, so two_heads is no.

A dried seed ball lies on a concrete slab, seen from above, with seed hairs scattered beside it. The seeds have gone, so growth_stage is after_seed_fall and usual_look is false. The top view is an unusual angle. Kind and shape are clear. No twig is shown, so hang is no.
A green, unripe seed ball hangs from a stalk under large lobed leaves. Kind, shape, and hang are clear. One ball shows, so two_heads is no.
A green, unripe seed ball hangs on a long stalk against a dark, soft background. Kind, shape, and hang are clear. One ball shows, so two_heads is no.
Two green, unripe seed balls hang on one stalk under a large leaf. All four fruit features are clear, so two_heads is clear. Green means unripe, so usual_look is false.

A crown of green Platanus leaves fills the frame, with no fruit or bark in focus, so the part is other and no feature check applies. The leaves blend into a mass, which would be leaf_mass if this were a leaf photo.

A small green, spiky seed ball on a stalk, among brown autumn leaves and the trunk, in warm low sun. The fruit is small in the frame, so kind, shape and hang are search. Warm backlight is a light cause. Green means unripe. One ball shows, so two_heads is no.

A dark brown dried seed ball hangs among green leaves. The ball is small in the frame, so kind, shape and hang are search. Brown and dry means ripe. The leaves behind crowd the frame, so alone is false. One ball shows, so two_heads is no.

Several dried seed balls hang from bare winter branches against a plain blue sky. The nearest ball is sharp and whole, and the others are soft behind it. Kind, shape and hang are clear. The balls do not share one stalk, so two_heads is no.
